jobs.title: Asset Manager
jobs.description: The Beverage RTM Asset Manager leads the strategy and governance of Monde Nissin’s beverage chiller and cold-asset portfolio across channels, customers, and territories. The role ensures that assets are strategically deployed, commercially productive, properly maintained, and managed throughout their lifecycle in support of beverage growth and route-to-market priorities. Key Responsibilities Lead the strategy, planning, budgeting, and productivity management of beverage chillers, coolers, and other cold assets. Manage the end-to-end asset deployment process, including outlet qualification, approvals, installation, tagging, handover, and post-deployment review. Optimize asset placement, capacity, assortment, visibility, and utilization to improve cold availability and beverage conversion. Govern asset maintenance and lifecycle management, including repairs, preventive maintenance, refurbishment, replacement, redeployment, recovery, and retirement. Drive cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Procurement, distributors, customers, and service providers to ensure strong execution and governance.

jobs.title: BTL & Activation Specialist
jobs.description: The BTL & Activation Specialist supports the sourcing, costing, and execution of BTL activations, events, and other on-ground marketing activities. The role focuses on identifying, evaluating, and managing reliable suppliers, production partners, venues, manpower providers, fabricators, and other service providers needed for successful campaign execution. The position works closely with Account Management, Creative, Finance, and Operations to translate campaign requirements into practical and cost-effective solutions. Summary Supplier & Partner Management Source, evaluate, and manage reliable suppliers and production partners for BTL and on-ground activations. Build and maintain a supplier database and strong vendor relationships. Assess supplier capabilities, pricing, quality, reliability, and capacity. Monitor supplier performance and negotiate competitive rates, payment terms, and other commercial conditions. BTL & Activation Sourcing & Costing Source suppliers, venues, manpower, and production solutions based on campaign requirements and client briefs. Support sourcing for brand activations, roadshows, mall/retail activations, trade events, sampling, product launches, exhibitions/booths, pop-ups, experiential marketing, POSM, logistics, and production. Scout and recommend suitable suppliers, venues, fabricators, and manpower providers. Request, compare, and analyze supplier quotations and prepare cost estimates. Support proposal and budget development with Account Management and Operations. Identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality and campaign requirements. Provide cost comparisons, recommendations, and identify potential risks or hidden costs. Help monitor project costs against approved budgets. Activation & Production Execution Coordinate with suppliers and internal teams from pre-production to project completion. Ensure suppliers understand project requirements, timelines, quality standards, and deliverables. Coordinate production schedule
